# ITB Transfer

> Private, fixed-price transfers between Istanbul Airport (IST), Sabiha Gökçen Airport (SAW), the Galataport cruise port and any hotel, home or office in Istanbul. Operated by 3E Seyahat Organizasyon Turizm ve Taşımacılık Ltd. Şti. (TÜRSAB licence no. 12556), Yenişehir Mahallesi, Şefika Sokak 4/452, Pendik/İstanbul/Türkiye. Prices are per car, not per person, and include tolls, parking, meet & greet and VAT.

Key facts (from the website, 2026-10-27):
- Meeting point at IST: Exit 13 of the arrivals hall, at the 3E sign. At SAW: inside the TÜRSAB building opposite column 5 (tell reception "3E").
- 60 minutes of free waiting from the flight's actual landing time; flights are tracked and a delay costs nothing extra. Hotel and address pickups: 20 minutes from the pickup time. Galataport cruise port: 30 minutes from the agreed pickup time, in front of the Carrefour supermarket at the Galataport exit (no waiting area for cars, so passenger and driver agree the time on WhatsApp). Longer waiting is charged per 15 minutes only when agreed.
- Free cancellation at least 24 hours before pickup; changes requested at least 24 hours ahead have no change fee. Full terms: https://www.istanbultaxibooking.com/legal
- Payment: cash to the driver in TRY, EUR or USD; companies can pay by monthly invoice.
- Cruise passengers: transfers between Galataport and IST, SAW or any hotel, and a car with driver for a day in port (8 or 10 hours, from €160 for 8 hours in Economy, per car). A licensed tour guide on request by WhatsApp or e-mail. Groups of more than 16: larger vehicles on request by WhatsApp. Details: https://www.istanbultaxibooking.com/galataport-cruise-port-transfer
- Peak hours: pickups at IST 15:00–19:00 and at SAW 14:45–21:00 cost 20% more.
- Vehicles: Economy (3 passengers), Standard Class (3), First Class (3), Van Standard (7), Van First Class (6), Minibus (16).
- Sample Economy prices, one way per car: IST–Taksim €42, IST–Sultanahmet €46, SAW–Kadıköy €45, IST–SAW €65.
- Contact: WhatsApp and phone +90 541 334 21 02 (24/7), info@istanbultaxibooking.com
- Booking: https://www.istanbultaxibooking.com/ (12 languages). The form sends a booking request; we e-mail a summary at once and the booking is confirmed when we send the confirmation e-mail with the voucher. Driver details follow by e-mail no later than 2 hours before pickup.
- Included in every transfer price: meet & greet, flight tracking, tolls, parking and VAT. Extras: child seat €10 per seat per transfer, extra stop €20–70 by vehicle (Economy €20, Van Standard €25, Minibus €30, Standard Class €45, Van First Class €50, First Class €70), return leg 10% off when booked together.
- Special days (holidays, festivals): a booking with a return transfer gets €5 more off the return transfer when a transfer date falls on one of them, applied automatically. Dates: https://www.istanbultaxibooking.com/offers
